robot.description: Pinned integrated dual-arm robot identity; movable base and shared lift. Submitted poses are evidence state, not fixed design constraints.

workspace.description: Variable multi-table room design permissions are fixed; geometry is a versioned submission output.

values.room: Propose bounded room dimensions and reasons; version subsequent changes.
values.tables: Variable count, dimensions, height, position and orientation; no universal count cap.
values.invariants: Real equipment scale, source quantities, physical interfaces and required operations.
values.clearance: Whole robot and tools, door/lid opening, loading, maintenance and required separation.
values.docking: Multiple docks per instrument/operation; either arm, shared lift.
values.compactness: Justify table sharing, dimensions and room extent; necessary clearance is not waste.

runtime.description: Simulator/version, timestep, solver, controller, reset, observation and contact sampling settings.

nominal_tolerances.description: Per source property: nominal/range, unit, provenance, measurement method and evaluator allowance; never manufacturer accuracy by invention.

geometry_precision.description: Per interface numerical geometry/contact uncertainty and allowed penetration, distinct from physical fit allowance.

stability.description: Per handled object and action: settling window, displacement, angular drift, velocity and permitted intentional deformation.

budget.description: Equal generation/repair/planning/control budgets, seeds, attempt counts, timeouts and model-cost reporting.

values.attempt_selection: Must be frozen before comparative execution; no best-run cherry picking.

allocation.description: Per task source quantities, sample realization, balancing instances and occurrence manifest fixed before submissions.

comparison_reference.description: Like-for-like achieved-goal reference for efficiency or an evidence-supported simplification comparison.

intervention_policy.description: Baseline supports, allowed extra actuators, physical assistance and device software interfaces.

values.allowed_extra_actuators: Reuse stock grippers. Declare task-specific adapters/replacements, arm, interface, payload and reasons. No second robot or undeclared powered assistance. Cooperative load sharing requires separate evidence.

candidate_configuration.note: Old FR3 snapshot is preserved in the baseline archive, not an active environment.

fixed_policy.external_handling: No invisible human relay or extra robot.
fixed_policy.initial_state: Input-declared fine fabrication, prepared contents and installed equipment may be precompleted.
fixed_policy.device_dwell: Declared virtual-clock abstraction allowed; retain all required external handling.
fixed_policy.modeling_freedom: Unpublished values must be declared and physically consistent; no hidden manufacturer target.
fixed_policy.task_feasibility: Before runtime comparison, validate full-scale workspace coexistence and witness configurations for required interfaces. Mark unresolved configuration as such, not as algorithm failure.
fixed_policy.scope_change: If a common fixed profile cannot support a task, revise the benchmark profile or explicitly version the task scope before comparing systems. Never shrink equipment silently.

freeze_procedure: Resolve each group with provenance and units.
Prepare per-task instance/occurrence manifests and signed feasibility records.
Record reviewer, date and profile hash before seeing comparative submissions.
Keep unaffected static/identity checks usable while specific groups remain pending.
